user.title: Connect to the Enet Smart Home server
user.description: Enter the address and the login of your Enet Smart Home server.

data_description.url: Address of the Enet Smart Home server, for example http://192.168.1.10. Use https:// if the server is set up for it.
data_description.username: User name used to log in to the Enet Smart Home server.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the Enet Smart Home server
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the login of your Enet Smart Home server.

data_description.url: Address of the Enet Smart Home server, for example http://192.168.1.10. Use https:// if the server is set up for it.
data_description.username: User name used to log in to the Enet Smart Home server.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The Enet Smart Home server at {url} rejected the login. Enter the username and password again.

data_description.username: User name used to log in to the Enet Smart Home server.

abort.discovery_not_supported: An Enet Smart Home server was discovered, but setting it up from discovery is not supported yet. Please add the integration manually.

init.title: Enet Smart Home settings
init.description: The integration reloads after saving. To change the address or the login of the server, use Reconfigure in the menu of the integration.

data.double_press_window: Double press: maximum time between the presses
data.verify_commands: Verify commands to lights and switches

data_description.double_press_window: Two short presses of the same button within this time are a double press.
data_description.location_scenes: Scenes the server creates for every location, like all lights off. Scenes with [libenet] in the name are always added.
data_description.verify_commands: Read the real state from the server after a command. If the server did not execute it, the state is corrected and the event enet_command_unconfirmed is fired.
data_description.verify_delay: Time after a command before the state is read from the server.
data_description.unavailable_after_failures: Number of failed event requests in a row after which all entities become unavailable.
data_description.request_timeout: Time after which a request to the server fails.
data_description.log_server_responses: Write the responses of the server to the log, to find problems. Also enable debug logging in the menu of the integration.
